name: Revvity PhenoPlate 384 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Revvity PhenoPlate 384 well, black, optically clear flat bottom, tissue-culture treated, with lids. Formerly sold as PerkinElmer CellCarrier-384 Ultra. Dimensions from the dimensioned engineering drawing in Revvity Technical Data Sheet 0PD384Ph-24091, pages 2-3. Units in meters. Footprint 127.76 x 85.48 mm +/- 0.2, overall height 14.35 mm +/- 0.1, skirt height 2 mm, plate planarity 0.1 mm. Well spacing (pitch) 4.5 mm on both axes. A1 well center is 12.13 mm +/- 0.2 from the left edge and 8.99 mm +/- 0.2 from the top edge. Wells are SQUARE, not round: 3.70 mm across at the top and 3.26 mm at the bottom (the drawing uses the square symbol on both callouts). The 'diameter' field carries the 3.70 mm top width, since the schema has no separate square-well side field. Bottom is a 0.188 mm cyclic olefin film with refractive index 1.53, sitting 0.21 mm above the plate underside; the drawing labels that 0.21 mm explicitly as bottom height. Maximum volume 145 uL per well; working volume is not published. WELL DEPTH IS DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED: the drawing gives only a bracketed reference dimension (13.1) from the underside datum, so depth is taken as 13.1 minus the 0.21 mm bottom height, about 12.89 mm. That is consistent with the stated 145 uL maximum. Revvity publishes no ANSI/SBS compliance statement, though the footprint, height and pitch all match the standard. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
